methodology: Expanding, selected, attributed incident and regional report catalogue affecting Assyrian people and historically linked Syriac and other Christian church communities. Entries may cover distinct single events, town-level episodes, or broad campaigns, with overlapping episodes sometimes cross-referenced in their descriptions. Source evidence ranges from scholarly history and formal human-rights reports to attributed community accounts. A reported allegation is not presented as a proven finding. The heat map represents the number of catalogue entries, not victims, severity, persecution rates, or unique campaigns. Country inclusion follows the recorded location of an event, not the residence of witnesses or exiles. Place coordinates are approximate and may identify only the town or region. Unrepresented countries do not imply absence of persecution.
